from.name: Business Loan Agreement
from.description: A small business loan: principal, APR, term and payment schedule.

body.p: This Business Loan Agreement is made as of {{effective}} between Larkspire Bank (the "Lender") and **{{borrower}}** (the "Borrower").
The Lender lends the Borrower a principal amount of US$ {{principal}} at an annual percentage rate of {{apr}}%, for {{term}} months.
The Borrower repays principal and interest in equal {{schedule}} installments over the term, starting one period after the date above. The Borrower may prepay without penalty.
If a payment is more than 15 days late, or the Borrower becomes insolvent, the Lender may declare the whole loan due at once.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

name: Business Loan Agreement (KBA)
summary: The small business loan agreement: each borrower passes knowledge-based authentication (IDV US KBA) before signing; the bank officer countersigns last. The loan system's values fill the terms.
